Questions

Frequently asked questions

Do I need to speak English?

Your conversations with Łukasz can be entirely in Polish. Some insurer steps (such as a phone health interview) may be in English or with an interpreter — Łukasz tells you in advance how it works. Policies and applications are issued in English, and Łukasz explains every part of them.

Do I have to be a US citizen?

Not always. Citizenship and immigration-status requirements depend on the insurer and the product — Łukasz will check this at the start.

What does a conversation cost?

Nothing. An agent is paid a commission by the insurer when a policy is issued — you do not pay for the conversation. If you buy nothing, you owe nothing.
